description: Transactions admitted or refused by the topic manager's rules (docs/spec.md section 8.1), in the order given there. Each case is the transaction as raw hex and as BEEF with its ancestry; the BEEF of a mined transaction also carries the transactions its inputs spend, because the anchor rules read their outputs; admission runs against the headers below, the topic's stream, and the case's producer policy. scriptsVerify says whether the transaction's own inputs pass the script interpreter: the refusals where it is true are spends anyone could make without the key, which only these rules catch. rule names the frozen-list row a refusal exercises. Signatures are deterministic (RFC 6979), so the bytes are reproducible.
headersNote: merkleRoot is in display byte order, as a txid is printed

transactions.name: carrier-seq-1
transactions.note: a batch carrier: full-bytes lines, spending funding-tree output 0

transactions.name: carrier-seq-2
transactions.note: a batch carrier: full-bytes lines+gzip, spending funding-tree output 1; prev is carrier-seq-1's commitment

transactions.name: carrier-seq-3
transactions.note: a batch carrier: digest-only, spending funding-tree output 2; prev is carrier-seq-2's commitment

transactions.name: anchor-interval-1
transactions.note: the anchor token of interval 1 (seq 1 to 2), spending funding-tree output 3 and a fee coin; mined

transactions.name: anchor-interval-2
transactions.note: the anchor token of interval 2 (seq 3), spending interval 1's token and a fee coin; mined

transactions.name: funding-tree
transactions.note: a mined funding tree: outputs 0 to 3 are funding outputs and are admitted; output 4 is change

transactions.name: funding-tree-unmined
transactions.note: the same funding tree with no proof: it claims nothing and admits nothing

transactions.name: sweep
transactions.note: a mined sweep of funding-tree outputs 0 and 1: its tombstone, output 0, is admitted as a funding output; it retracts carrier-seq-1 and carrier-seq-2

transactions.name: carrier-closed-policy-admits
transactions.note: carrier-seq-1 under a closed policy that names its producer

transactions.name: carrier-two-inputs
transactions.note: carrier-seq-1's output with a second funding input

transactions.name: carrier-two-outputs
transactions.note: carrier-seq-1's output with 999 and a second output of 1

transactions.name: carrier-value-short
transactions.note: the one output carries 999 of the input's 1000
